name: Shioji
source:
[i]"Why not let Tobari be and come with me instead? I promise you'll be in good hands."[/i]

An entertainment district local and second-in-command of the Shiranui. He's more approachable compared to Tobari. Considers Tobari to be his little brother.

[From [url=https://www.aksysgames.com/itehari/characters/]Aksys Games[/url]]
